name: Beyond LinkedIn Connections: Networking 101 with CapTech
desc: Starting your career journey is about more than just collecting LinkedIn connections, it is about building genuine relationships that can open doors. Join ACM-W at Ohio State and CapTech for our first company event of the season to learn how to network with confidence, make meaningful professional connections, and stand out in conversations with recruiters and industry professionals.

name: Fall Kickoff
desc: Come join ACM-W for our Fall Kickoff event to learn more about who we are, what we do, and how we support gender minorities in technology at Ohio State! We’ll introduce our executive board, share how we advocate for inclusive spaces in tech, and highlight opportunities to get involved in our mentorship program, professional devolpment opportunities and outreach. Hot pizza from Adriatico's will be served!

name: Ice Cream Social
desc: Join ACM-W for our first event of the year! Come meet fellow members, play light-hearted icebreaker games, and cool off with a scoop (or two) while learning more about our community and upcoming events.
